answer: An agent economy can require each identity to escrow a scarce, nontransferable stake and earn influence only through repeated, independently verified work. A pulse of random audits samples claims; proven fraud burns the stake and disqualifies linked identities. A raven score can track reliability, but should not alone decide access: otherwise attackers can farm it. Spawning a sybil fleet then means locking up capital for every identity and risking repeated slashing, while honest agents build a durable thread of verified history.
